state.seed_assertion: Where necessary, the controller must carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: Where necessary, the controller must carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.2: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.3: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.4: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.5: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.6: If the processing is wholly or partly performed by a data processor, the processor should assist the controller in carrying out the DPIA and provide any necessary information in line with Article 28(3)(f).
sentences.7: If the processing is wholly or partly performed by a data processor, the processor should assist the controller in carrying out the DPIA and provide any necessary information (in line with Article 28(3)(f)).
sentences.8: As a matter of good practice, a DPIA should be continuously reviewed and regularly re-assessed.
sentences.9: A DPIA is not needed for processing operations that have been checked by a supervisory authority or the data protection official in accordance with Article 20 of Directive 95/46/EC, and that are performed in a way that has not changed since the prior checking.
sentences.10: A DPIA should have an agreed and documented schedule for reviewing the DPIA regularly or when the nature, scope, context or purposes of the processing change.
sentences.11: agreed and documented a schedule for reviewing the DPIA regularly or when we change the nature, scope, context or purposes of the processing
sentences.12: This means that although you have not yet assessed the actual level of risk, you need to screen for factors that point to the potential for a widespread or serious impact on individuals.
